title: Kev: Tiny Jev-like family of decision models built on top of Qwen3.5
summary: Kev is a lightweight family of decision-making AI models built on Qwen3.5 by Jared Palmer, designed to be small and efficient like the Jev project. It provides accessible decision-making capabilities that can run with fewer computational resources, making local AI deployment more practical.
problem_solved: Makes decision-making AI models more accessible by creating lightweight alternatives that can run locally with minimal resources
why_valuable: Enables developers to deploy efficient decision-making AI without heavy infrastructure costs, democratizing access to local LLM-based decision systems
